extDescription.message: Bilingual subtitles for YouTube, tuned for long interviews and tech podcasts.
extDescription.description: One-line description in the store and the extensions list

cmdToggle.message: Toggle translated subtitles for this video

boxDragTip.message: Drag to move · double-click to reset

boxWidthTip.message: Drag to resize the box · double-click to reset

boxError.message: · translation failed — open the extension popup ·

errBackendSilent.message: The background never answered; this batch was dropped (you can retry)

errRateWait.message: Rate limited — retrying automatically in $1 s

stNoSub.message: This video has no usable subtitle track

stNoSubLang.message: No usable subtitle track (audio detected as $1)

errAuth.message: The API key is wrong, or it lacks permission

errFormat.message: The model didn't return one line per input line

errNetwork.message: Can't reach the endpoint — check your network and API address

hintNone.message: Off is usually enough for subtitles: fastest and cheapest.

hintLow.message: A little thinking — steadier on long sentences, puns and jargon.

hintMedium.message: Most faithful, but clearly slower and pricier. Save it for hard interviews.

srcMissing.message: Missing: $1　·　waiting for an extension update

srcAdopted.message: Using the video's own $1 subtitles — no tokens spent

srcDubbedHint.message: switch back to the original audio and it translates again

srcOnlyOne.message: This video has only this one subtitle track

srcNoAudioTrack.message: No $1 subtitle track — the existing track has to serve as the source

pfNoModel.message: No model yet — set one in options

diagCopyFailed.message: Copy failed — printed to the console instead

popupPurge.message: Subtitles out of sync? Re-translate this video

popupPurgeTip.message: Throw away the cached translation for this video and start over

popupSetup.message: No endpoint configured yet — add an API address and key

popupFontHint.message: Scales up with the player in fullscreen; this is the baseline for a small window.

popupCopyDiagTip.message: Copy recent status, errors and request summaries for a bug report (no API key)

optSub.message: Detects the spoken language and translates YouTube subtitles into one you read at a glance — bilingual by default.

optProfileNote.message: The five fields on this card belong to the current profile; every other setting is shared. Switching profiles re-translates existing subtitles.

optBaseUrlNote.message: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint; ending at /v1 is enough. If it is already a full path, add # at the end.

optKeyNote.message: Stored only in this browser. Never synced, never sent anywhere else.

optModelNote.message: Changing models means changing this field only.

optLangAuto.message: auto: follows the browser ($1); currently translating into “$2”.

optLangFixed.message: Always translating into “$1”. Set it back to auto to follow the browser.

optStyleEffort.message: reasoning_effort, field omitted when off · conservative

optStyleNote.message: This only decides which field name is sent; the level is chosen in the popup. Only the first option can truly turn reasoning off — switch styles only when the provider answers 400.

optSaveTokenLead.message: Batching, look-ahead, concurrency, context and caching are already tuned for long podcasts and are no longer exposed. This section only controls how long the cache lives.

optCacheDaysNote.message: Cleared only after this long without being watched; rewatching restarts the clock.

optCacheMaxNote.message: Above this, the least recently watched go first.

optDensityCompact.message: Compact · fits one line where possible (~96 chars)

optDensityStandard.message: Standard · balances completeness and height (~130 chars)

optDensityFull.message: Full · never splits long sentences (~180 chars)

optFontSerif.message: Elegant serif · Georgia + Source Han Serif

optFontSans.message: Modern sans · Inter + Source Han Sans

optOrigScaleNote.message: Original and translation share one colour; only size separates them.

optBgNote.message: Fully transparent at the far left, leaving only outlined text. Keep a little for bright videos.

optWidthNote.message: The box hugs its content; this is the upper bound. Wider means fewer wrapped lines.

optResetPos.message: Put the box back at bottom centre

optDragNote.message: Hover the subtitle box in the video: the dot moves it, the bars resize it, double-click resets.

optPermMissing.message: No permission to reach $1 yet — translation will fail.

optResetLead.message: Puts every setting back to factory values. Cache and usage stats are left alone.

optKeepApiNote.message: (profiles, address, key, model, target language, reasoning style)

optResetHint.message: Click twice to confirm. Cannot be undone.

fontSerifNote.message: Roomy letterforms, easy on the eyes over hours.

fontSansNote.message: Sturdiest strokes — safest at small sizes or low quality.

fontKaiNote.message: Handwritten feel with thin strokes; pair with a large size and a dark backdrop.

densityCompactNote.message: Shortest box; long sentences get chopped a bit.

densityStandardNote.message: Recommended. Whole sentences first, long ones split at commas.

densityFullNote.message: Most coherent, but a line can reach four rows on screen.

cardNoPermBody.message: No permission to reach that API address; the test was cancelled.

cardWarnBurning.message: Set to “off”, yet it burned $1 reasoning tokens. Try the first style and test again; if the provider rejects it, this model cannot turn reasoning off.

cardWarnIdle.message: The level is “$1” but not a single reasoning token was spent — this model may not support reasoning, or it doesn't accept this style.

statNoPrefixReport.message: Prefix cache: the provider doesn't report it

statOldest.message: oldest entry last used $1 days ago
